title: Puttering Pebble-Puffer
statement: Drifting through warm teal water lit by dappled sunbeams and towering ribbons of translucent kelp, this round, starry-eyed pufferfish hovers with quiet curiosity above pale quartz sand. Between gentle puffs of silver bubbles, it spends its days sorting iridescent pebbles into neat, glowing constellations around a sunken brass astrolabe.
